description:
Title: Ordering in an Online Shop  

A customer that logs into an E-Shop system and has to wait for its login confirmation (its credentials are checked by the system).
If the login was successful then the customer can continue to select products, else the shopping experience stops.
After selecting a product the customer has to add it to a shopping cart, save the product and check if every product was already selected.
These steps repeat until all products were selected.
Then the order is finished by the shopping system and simultaneously payment and shipment for the order is prepared.
For the payment the customer has to enter its payment data and has to wait until the bank confirms the payment.
While waiting for the payment confirmation the customer can enter its shipping address (an independent billing address can be entered if the shipping address is not equal to the billing address).
Finally if the address and the payment steps are executed then the order will be finished by the system.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OnlineShopOrdering" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/online-shop-ordering">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Bank" name="Bank"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_CredentialsToSystem" name="Login credentials" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCredentials" targetRef="StartEvent_LoginReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginConfirmationToCustomer" name="Login confirmation" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginConfirmed" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_LoginFailureToCustomer" name="Login failure" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginFailed" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderToSystem" name="Order submitted" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentDataToBank" name="Payment data" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData" targetRef="Participant_Bank"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_PaymentConfirmationToCustomer" name="Payment confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Bank" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_AddressAndPaymentToSystem" name="Address and payment completed" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAddressAndPayment" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AddressAndPaymentReceived"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StartShopping" name="Start shopping"/>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginResult" messageRef="Msg_LoginResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_LoginCheck" name="Login successful?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped" name="Shopping stopped"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductLoopMerge" name="Product selection loop"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_SelectProduct" name="Select product"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AddToCart" name="Add product to shopping cart"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SaveProduct" name="Save product"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_CheckAllProductsSelected" name="Customer checks whether all products were selected"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" name="All products selected?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SubmitOrder" name="Submit order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" name="Split payment and address"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterPaymentData" name="Enter payment data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendPaymentData" name="Send payment data"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed" name="Payment confirmation received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_PaymentConfirmed" messageRef="Msg_PaymentConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterShippingAddress" name="Enter shipping address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" name="Billing address differs from shipping address?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterBillingAddress" name="Enter billing address"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Address step done"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin" name="Address and payment entered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendAddressAndPayment" name="Send address and payment"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CustomerDone" name="Address and payment sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C01" sourceRef="StartEvent_StartShopping" targetRef="UserTask_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C02" sourceRef="UserTask_Login" targetRef="SendTask_SendCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C03" sourceRef="SendTask_SendCredentials" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C04" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_LoginResult" targetRef="Gateway_LoginCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ProductLoopMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_LoginCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_ShoppingStopped">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${loginSuccessful == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C07" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductLoopMerge" targetRef="UserTask_SelectProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C08" sourceRef="UserTask_SelectProduct" targetRef="UserTask_AddToCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C09" sourceRef="UserTask_AddToCart" targetRef="Task_SaveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C10" sourceRef="Task_SaveProduct" targetRef="ManualTask_CheckAllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C11" sourceRef="ManualTask_CheckAllProductsSelected" targetRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C12" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="Gateway_ProductLoopMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C13" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AllProductsSelected" targetRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allProductsSelected == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C14" sourceRef="SendTask_SubmitOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C15" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" targetRef="UserTask_EnterPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C16" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterPaymentData" targetRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C17" sourceRef="SendTask_SendPaymentData" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C18" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PaymentConfirmed" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C19" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressSplit" targetRef="UserTask_EnterShippingAddress"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C20" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterShippingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C21" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" targetRef="UserTask_EnterBillingAddress">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C22" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingAddressDiffers" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${billingAddressDiffers == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C23" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterBillingAddress" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C24" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C25" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentAddressJoin" targetRef="SendTask_SendAddressAndPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C26" sourceRef="SendTask_SendAddressAndPayment" targetRef="EndEvent_CustomerDone"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_EShopSystem" name="E-Shop System" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_LoginReceived" name="Login credentials received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_LoginReceived" messageRef="Msg_LoginCredentials"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_CheckCredentials" name="Check credentials"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CredentialsValid" name="Credentials valid?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginConfirmed" name="Send login confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_LoginFailed" name="Send login failure"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LoginRejected" name="Login rejected"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_OrderSubmitted" name="Order submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OrderSubmitted" messageRef="Msg_OrderSubmitted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_FinishOrder" name="Finish order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Split payment and shipment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PreparePayment" name="Prepare payment"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_PrepareShipment" name="Prepare shipment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Payment and shipment prepared"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_AddressAndPaymentReceived" name="Address and payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_AddressAndPayment" messageRef="Msg_AddressAndPayment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_FinalizeOrder" name="Finalize order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderFinished" name="Order finished"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S01" sourceRef="StartEvent_LoginReceived" targetRef="ServiceTask_CheckCredentials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S02" sourceRef="ServiceTask_CheckCredentials" targetRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S03" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendTask_LoginConfirmed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S04" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CredentialsValid" targetRef="SendTask_LoginFailed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${credentialsValid == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S05" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginConfirmed" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OrderSubmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S06" sourceRef="SendTask_LoginFailed" targetRef="EndEvent_LoginRejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S07" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OrderSubmitted" targetRef="ServiceTask_FinishOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S08" sourceRef="ServiceTask_FinishOrder" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S09" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="ServiceTask_PreparePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S10" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="ServiceTask_PrepareShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S11" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PreparePayment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S12" sourceRef="ServiceTask_PrepareShipment" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S13" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AddressAndPaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S14" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_AddressAndPaymentReceived" targetRef="ServiceTask_FinalizeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_S15" sourceRef="ServiceTask_FinalizeOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
